method: Native 48 kHz excerpts with 0.5 seconds before and after each selected active or mandatory interval. Remote residual is master channel 0 minus the exact simultaneously recorded backing channel 0. Sender reference uses one constant locally correlated offset per context only when NCC >=0.2 with a unique peak; otherwise it retains the clock-derived hint and is explicitly unidentified. No stretching, resampling, gain normalization or dynamics. Context NCC is for clip identity only, not a replacement lag/drift acceptance result.

events.originalClassification: Accepted by unchanged approved 1s timing method; this context does not replace that gate
events.senderHintMethod: Independent effective packet-clock hint from exact receiver CSV presentation minus selected deadline; context NCC may refine one constant offset only

classificationCaveat: Local wider-context identification does not reclassify UNKNOWN active intervals or repair failed mandatory cells. Nonzero residual/PLC is not proof of recovered original phonemes.
selection: Minimal audit contexts: A representative 80ms UNKNOWN and failed mandatory cell; B identified control. Other full-source evidence remains local.
